import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def compute_bleu(generated, reference, max_n=4):
    ref_tokens = reference.lower().split()
    gen_tokens = generated.lower().split()
    precisions = []
    for n in range(1, max_n + 1):
        ref_ngrams = [tuple(ref_tokens[i:i+n]) for i in range(len(ref_tokens)-n+1)]
        gen_ngrams = [tuple(gen_tokens[i:i+n]) for i in range(len(gen_tokens)-n+1)]
        ref_counts = Counter(ref_ngrams)
        gen_counts = Counter(gen_ngrams)
        overlap = sum((ref_counts & gen_counts).values())
        precisions.append(overlap / max(len(gen_ngrams), 1))
    ref_len = len(ref_tokens)
    gen_len = len(gen_tokens)
    bp = min(1, np.exp(1 - ref_len / max(gen_len, 1)))
    bleu = bp * np.exp(np.mean([np.log(p + 1e-10) for p in precisions]))
    return bleu
